title: US Business Entity Status & Good Standing Monitor
description: Is this US company in good standing, and when is its annual report due? Normalized status, good standing and annual report due dates from official open data (CO, CT, DC, NY, OR, TX), plus change alerts when an entity becomes delinquent, suspended or dissolved. No login, no proxy.
seoTitle: US Business Good Standing & Annual Report Monitor
seoDescription: Check US business entity status, good standing and annual report due dates across states and get change alerts for delinquent, suspended or dissolved companies.

entity-check.eventDescription: One entity returned with canonical status, good standing and annual report due date (name searches charge once per candidate returned).

change-alert.eventDescription: One alert per monitored entity whose status, good standing or annual report due date changed since the previous run (all of its changes are bundled in one alert).
